about: Judge calibration registry (RIMMANDRAKE_SEED_JUDGE_CALIBRATION_FROM_CORPORA; spec design/specs/2026-11-12-refusal-contract-for-judges-and-gates.md section 5). Keyed by family; `hash` is refusal_contract.brief_hash of `brief`. Only a CALIBRATED brief's verdict, either way, has a consequence (a refusal sends work back, a pass signs); any edit to a brief file resets it to UNTESTED (refusal_contract.py calibrate). A brief is CALIBRATED only by a check on its current hash whose case results show every `planted` case ran and came out as planted, good and bad both (refusal_contract.judge_cases; RIMMANDRAKE_EARN_CALIBRATION_BOTH_WAYS): `free_check` is deterministic and runs on every calibrate, `model_check` spends and runs only on `calibrate --model <family>`. `cases` is prose about the corpora a row was seeded from.
